limitations: No assessment average scale scores appear in this OSPI dataset; proficiency and participation counts/percentages are provided.
SBA values exclude alternate WA-AIM to avoid conflating alternate and general assessments.
September 2026 Report Card denominator changed from expected students to tested students; do not compare these rates with older downloads without accounting for denominator.
Privacy suppressed cells remain null and suppression technique is retained.
No complete verified public MAP schoolwide dataset located. School CSIPs often quote selected grade/subgroup growth or goals rather than schoolwide proficiency. These are not substituted.

104 annual CSIP PDFs were downloaded and reviewed for numerical MAP passages; some plans contain narrow grade/subgroup projections or goals and ambiguously dated whole-school statistics. Source links and selected context are retained with limitations.
validation: Joined on explicit OSPI schoolorganizationid, not fuzzy name
Every proficiency percentage with released counts cross-checked against proficient/tested counts; percentages retained when only counts suppressed
Every released proficiency percentage between 0 and foundational percentage; foundational percentage <=100
